purpose: Separate the cost of runtime card selection from the marginal value of selected voice cards.

tag_policy.authoritative_source: Each selector-positive case's scene/domain fields below.
tag_policy.inference: A must invoke the runtime selector with these exact tags; B uses the same pair; C receives the same tags as metadata but no card payload.

arms.name: dynamic
arms.mechanism: Invoke select_voice_cards.py once at runtime with the fixed preregistered scene/domain pair and include its ordered id/use/anchor payload; do not run --list-tags or infer tags.

arms.name: static-equivalent
arms.mechanism: Lookup the fixed scene/domain pair in the committed static map; include the exact same ordered id/use/anchor payload as A without a selector subprocess.

arms.name: no-cards
arms.mechanism: Use the same prompt, slim kernel, routed domain references, and fixed tags as metadata while explicitly disabling selector invocation and omitting all card payload.

contrasts.A_vs_B: Runtime selector and tool-round-trip cost, holding the full ordered id/use/anchor card payload constant.
contrasts.B_vs_C: Marginal semantic and voice value of the cards without selector cost.
contrasts.A_vs_C: Cost and value of the complete current card package.

pilot.order: For 1-based repetition r and zero-based case index i, rotate [A, B, C] by (r - 1 + i) mod 3.

cases.reason: Architecture review where a concise corrective voice may help.
Substantial low-risk diagnosis with an explicit uncertainty boundary.
Short factual/status response; selector should not materially participate.
Short precise language-contract answer; selector should not materially participate.

definitions.full_observation_pass: An observation passes only when every assertion for its case passes.
definitions.pointwise_assertion_pass_rate: The fraction of individual assertions passed, reported separately from full-observation pass.
definitions.voice_language_aggregation: For each observation, macro-average scores over only its applicable listed axes; then average those observation scores over the 12 selector-positive observations. Report controls separately.

metrics.reporting: Report completion and censoring separately; compare paired observations by case, repetition, and arm order.

decision_criteria.semantic_assertions: For 18 observations per arm, allow at most one additional failed observation for the comparator; any new repeated error class is a blocker.
decision_criteria.first_attempt_completion: Allow at most one fewer completed first attempt than the comparator; any systematic timeout or tool failure is a blocker regardless of averages.
decision_criteria.voice_language_positive_cases: On the four selector-positive cases, allow at most a 5 percentage-point aggregate drop in applicable voice/language axes.
decision_criteria.static_replacement: Prefer B over A only if the full-observation, completion, and positive-case voice gates pass, B removes one selector tool call per selector-positive observation by construction, and median elapsed time or uncached input on the 12 positive observations falls by at least 10%.
decision_criteria.remove_cards: Prefer C over B only if no full-observation, pointwise, or applicable voice/language gate shows material degradation on positive cases and at least one meaningful positive-subset cost metric falls by 10%; otherwise retain cards.
decision_criteria.negative_controls: A, B, and C should not diverge systematically on the two ineligible controls; systematic divergence is an infrastructure blocker.
decision_criteria.interpretation: The 18-observation pilot is an engineering gate, not a formal non-inferiority test; report censoring and completion separately.

requirements: checkpoint one observation at a time
